title: claude-settings mods update themselves after the first install
why: Your question, Oct 26: why did your claude-settings install never pick up the token-weather 500k fix? Mods were fetched once, on Oct 13, and never refreshed.
note: Mac live check passed Oct 27 11:35 CDT (local liaison). Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv, "agreeed"): mods stay current by marketplace auto-update alone, with no installer step. Cause, checked at main 3f71d6b: the claude-settings marketplace entry in settings.json had no "autoUpdate": true, and Claude Code leaves third-party marketplaces un-refreshed by default; install.sh and install.ps1 never touch plugins, by design (decision mods-install-via-marketplace). So each mod stayed at its first-install version (desktop-statusline 0.1.3 on the Mac against main's 0.1.5). Fix: PR #581 (mods auto-update from the claude-settings marketplace) merged Oct 26 in #586 (main e5525a6). Left: the Mac check below. One-off catch-up given to shiv: `claude plugin marketplace update claude-settings`, then `claude plugin update <mod>@claude-settings` per mod. Proof after merge, on the Mac: after the first session, `claude plugin list` shows each claude-settings mod at main's version. Placed beside c29 (triage, Oct 26): only the Mac check is left, and it carries c29's fix to the Mac. Oct 26 (page item 20): the Mac was already current; Windows is updating. Mac check passed Oct 27 11:35 CDT (local liaison, main 2ca89254): `claude plugin list` shows all five mods at main's versions (decision-watch 0.0.11, desktop-statusline 0.1.5, plain-diff 0.1.7, session-board 0.1.7, token-weather 0.1.2); the claude-settings marketplace has autoUpdate true, refreshed 09:43 CDT today. Done on the Mac. Closes once Windows is confirmed to update too (its note says it was updating Oct 26). Windows read Oct 28 13:48 CDT (shiv's PC session): `claude plugin list` shows all five mods matching origin/main and enabled at user scope (decision-watch 0.0.11, desktop-statusline 0.1.5, plain-diff 0.1.7, session-board 0.1.8, token-weather 0.1.2). Done.
